annotations.text: J (Numbered Spec Index): a clay numeral gutter indexes the four species 01 to 04 over hairlines with no boxes or zebra, so the African Grey lead row is carried by type weight and a small-caps label alone; the trade-off is that numbering species reads as a ranked checklist rather than a comparison, and it is the taller Mobile stack of the pair at 1,619px.

K (Menu Leaders): dot leaders run from each species to its three attributes with values right-aligned on a common axis, folding Noise level and Best for into one muted meta line at Tablet; the trade-off is that the sentence-length Best for cells wrap right-aligned and squeeze the leader run down to a stub on the African Grey row.
